questions.q: We must defend our country against the enemy ____ all circumstances.
questions.zh: 在任何情況下，我們必須對抗敵人保衛國家。
questions.explain: under all circumstances（在任何情況下）。

questions.q: The dictionary is sold ____ three hundred yuan a copy.
questions.zh: 這本詞典一本售價300元。
questions.explain: at＋單價（以某種價錢售出）。

questions.q: The house was finished ____ the morning of February 4th.
questions.zh: 這棟房子在二月四號的早上完成的。
questions.explain: on 用於特定某天的上、下午或晚上。

questions.q: Mrs. Johnson's old cat likes to sit ____ the sun.
questions.zh: 約翰遜太太的老貓喜歡躺在陽光中。
questions.explain: in the sun（陽光下）。

questions.q: He lives ____ 87 Nanking Road.
questions.zh: 他住在南京路87號。
questions.explain: live on＋街道名／live at＋門牌號碼。

questions.q: ____ the age of twenty, she was married to an old man.
questions.zh: 在二十歲時，她嫁給一個老頭。
questions.explain: at the age of（在…歲時）。

questions.q: How did he go to Keelung? He went ____ bus.
questions.zh: 他怎麼去基隆的？他坐公車去的。
questions.explain: by＋交通工具。

questions.q: ____ listening to conversation, you can learn something useful from everyone.
questions.zh: 通過聆聽別人的談話，你可以從他們那裡學到一些有用的東西。
questions.explain: by＋V-ing（藉…方法）。

questions.q: Which candidate are you voting ____?
questions.zh: 你要投哪一位候選人？
questions.explain: vote for（投票給…）。

questions.q: Please come to see me the day ____ tomorrow.
questions.zh: 請於後天來找（看）我。
questions.explain: 「後天」用 the day after tomorrow；「前天」用 the day before yesterday。

questions.q: He lost his job ____ doing something wrong.
questions.zh: 他因為做錯事而丟掉工作了。
questions.explain: for（由於…）表示原因。

questions.q: Can you swim ____ the river?
questions.zh: 你能游過河嗎？
questions.explain: across（越過；橫過）。

questions.q: John will go to college ____ high school.
questions.zh: 高中畢業後，約翰將入大學就讀。
questions.explain: after（在…之後）。

questions.q: You must keep it secret. It is only ____ you and me.
questions.zh: 你要保密。它是你我之間的秘密。
questions.explain: between... and（用於兩者之間）。

questions.q: Every night John studied hard and did his homework ____ 11:30 p.m.
questions.zh: 每天晚上約翰都很用功而且做功課到11點半。
questions.explain: until（直到…）。

questions.q: This teacher writes ____ his left hand.
questions.zh: 這位老師用左手寫字。
questions.explain: with＋受詞（用…）。

questions.q: ____ our baseball teams, Jim is the best player.
questions.zh: 在我們棒球隊中，Jim 是最好的球員。
questions.explain: among（在…之間）指三者以上。

questions.q: My father will be back ____ four.
questions.zh: 我父親在四點以前會回來。
questions.explain: by（＝before）（在…之前）。

questions.q: Don't do things ____ your will.
questions.zh: 不要作違背你意志的事。
questions.explain: against one's will（違背…本意）。

questions.q: The boy and the girl come ____ different parts of the country.
questions.zh: 這位男孩和女孩來自一個國家的不同地區。
questions.explain: come of（出身於）；come from（來自於）；come to（甦醒）；come along（進步）。

questions.q: I can't find Jinan ____ the map.
questions.zh: 我無法在地圖上找到濟南。
questions.explain: on the map（在地圖上）。

questions.q: The main feature began ____ 9 o'clock.
questions.zh: 首場電影正片九點開始。
questions.explain: at＋時刻。

questions.q: When you get out of the room, don't forget to turn ____ the light.
questions.zh: 當你離開房間時，不要忘了關燈。
questions.explain: turn off（關燈）。

questions.q: I have no hobbies ____ playing tennis.
questions.zh: 除了打網球，我沒有別的嗜好。
questions.explain: except（除了…之外）。

questions.q: The big fire ____ his parents.
questions.zh: 大火奪去了他的雙親。
questions.explain: deprive 人 of～（奪去某人～）。

questions.q: They have known each other ____. (複選)
questions.zh: 他們從1976年就已經認識了。／他們已經認識好幾年了。
questions.explain: since＋過去時間／for＋一段時間。

questions.q: A traffic accident prevented him ____ coming.
questions.zh: 車禍使他無法前來。
questions.explain: prevent 人 from＋V-ing（阻止某人做…）。

questions.q: She got a doctor degree ____. (複選)
questions.zh: 她二十幾歲（或：二十歲時）就得到博士學位。
questions.explain:
① in one's twenties（在二十幾歲）
② at the age of twenty（二十歲時）。

questions.q: The factory produces the most products ____ the lowest cost.
questions.zh: 這家工廠以最低價生產大多數的產品。
questions.explain: at... cost（以…價格）。

questions.q: My uncle left ____ Africa last week.
questions.zh: 我叔叔上星期前往非洲。
questions.explain: leave for（前往…）。

questions.q: He has lived here in Taichung ____ many years.
questions.zh: 他已經在台中住了許多年了。
questions.explain: for＋一段時間。

questions.q: The opening ceremony of the 23rd Olympiad was held ____ Los Angeles on Saturday, July 28, 1984.
questions.zh: 第23屆奧運會開幕典禮於1984年7月28日星期六在洛杉磯舉行。
questions.explain:
① be held（舉行）
② in＋大都市；at＋小地方。

questions.q: She is dressed ____ a pink suit ____ gold buttons.
questions.zh: 她穿著一件有金色鈕扣的粉紅色套裝。
questions.explain:
① be dressed in＋衣物／顏色（穿著～）
② with（帶有～）。

questions.q: We learn our own language ____ hearing people speak it.
questions.zh: 我們經由聽人們說話而學會自己的語言。
questions.explain: by（藉著～）。

questions.q: The workers are paid ____.
questions.zh: 這些工作人員按週計酬。
questions.explain: by the＋單位（以…計）。

questions.q: They decided to take a walk ____ the shore.
questions.zh: 他們決定要沿著河岸散步。
questions.explain: along（沿著）。

questions.q: "When were you born?" "I was born ____ December 8, 1961."
questions.zh: 「你何時出生？」「我是1961年12月8日生的。」
questions.explain: on＋特定日期。

questions.q: You may gain priceless profit ____ your studies.
questions.zh: 你可以從讀書中獲取極珍貴的益處。
questions.explain: from（從…）／from one's studies（從讀書中）。

questions.q: The electronic computer has been in use only ____ 1946.
questions.zh: 電腦從1946年起一直在使用。
questions.explain: 現在完成式（進行式）＋since（自從）＋過去時間。

questions.q: Retailers sell goods ____ higher prices than wholesalers do.
questions.zh: 零售商以比批發商高的價格銷售貨物。
questions.explain: at higher price（以較高價）。

questions.q: We can write letters ____ simple English.
questions.zh: 我們可以用簡單的英語寫信。
questions.explain: in English（用英語）。

questions.q: We are traveling ____ a speed of 90 kilometers an hour.
questions.zh: 我們正以每小時90公里的速度前進。
questions.explain: at a speed of（以…速度）。

questions.q: ____ a clear night we can look up at the sky and see into space.
questions.zh: 在明亮的夜晚，我們仰望天空，可以透視太空。
questions.explain: 介系詞 “on” 表示某一特定之時間或日子。

questions.q: They are leaving for Jinan ____.
questions.zh: 他們將於下午一點三十分前往濟南。
questions.explain:
① 介系詞 “at” 表示幾點鐘。
② p.m.（下午）應放在時間之後。

questions.q: They got over that difficulty ____ of different approaches. (複選)
questions.zh: 他們嘗試了許多不同的方法，藉以度過那次難關。
questions.explain:
① by＋V-ing 表示「方法」，譯為「藉…」或「靠」。
② get over＝overcome（克服；度過）。

questions.q: In the sentence, "The size of the room is 12' × 14'." the sign "×" is to read "____".
questions.zh: 在「該室大小是12'×14'」句中，“×”符號該念成 by。
questions.explain: “×”這個符號若表示「長×寬」，讀成 “by”；若表示「倍」或「乘以」，讀成 “times” 或 “multiplied by”。

questions.q: The office is open Monday ____ Saturday, and closed on Sundays.
questions.zh: 辦公時間是從週一到週六，星期天休息。
questions.explain: (from) Monday through Saturday（從週一到週六整整六天）。

questions.q: ____ prices so high, I'll have to do without a new suit this year.
questions.zh: 因為物價那麼高，所以今年只好不添新裝了。
questions.explain:
① “with＋名詞＋形容詞”，表示「原因」。
② 此題若用 because of，則原題應改為 Because of so high prices.

questions.q: In the photograph the man's face is ____ focus but the rest is blurred.
questions.zh: 這張照片中，此人臉部清晰可見，而其餘部分模糊不清。
questions.explain:
① in focus（在焦點內➜清晰）／out of focus（在焦點外➜模糊不清）。
② blurred：形 模糊的。

sections.title: （二）翻譯填空題
sections.instructions: 依中文提示完成英文句子，每格填入一適當的字詞

questions.q:
他日益虛弱，因為他常常從早上工作到晚上。
He is getting weak, because he often works ____ morning ____ night.
questions.zh: 他日益虛弱，因為他常常從早上工作到晚上。
questions.explain: from morning till night（從早到晚）。（亦可用 from... to...）

questions.q:
背後莫論人是非。
Never speak ill ____ others ____ their backs.
questions.zh: 背後莫論人是非。
questions.explain: speak ill of（批評）。

questions.q:
藉著語言，人與人之間可互相溝通。
____ ____ languages, people can communicate ____ each other.
questions.zh: 藉著語言，人與人之間可互相溝通。
questions.explain: by means of（藉著）；communicate with（溝通）。

questions.q:
他閒蕩終日，結果入學考試落榜了。
He ____ ____ all day long; ____ a ____, he failed in the entrance examination.
questions.zh: 他閒蕩終日，結果入學考試落榜了。
questions.explain:
① fool away＝idle away（虛度光陰；遊手好閒）
② as a result（因此）。

questions.q:
人生常被比喻為航海，而每個人都是自己命運之舵手。
Life is often ____ ____ a voyage, in which everyone is the ____ (or sailor) of his own ____ (or fate).
questions.zh: 人生常被比喻為航海，而每個人都是自己命運之舵手。
questions.explain:
① be compared with（與…做比較）
② be compared to（被比喻為）
③ 舵手可用 master 或 sailor，命運可用 fortune 或 fate。

questions.q:
無疑地，疾病由暴飲暴食而起。
It is ____ ____ that sickness ____ ____ eating and drinking excessively.
questions.zh: 無疑地，疾病由暴飲暴食而起。
questions.explain:
① result in＋結果（導致…結果）
② result from＋原因（導源於…原因）。

questions.q:
驕傲使他無法獲致更高的成就。
Pride ____ him ____ attaining ____ achievements.
questions.zh: 驕傲使他無法獲致更高的成就。
questions.explain: prevent/stop/keep... from＋V-ing（阻止…無法／不能…）。

questions.q:
這場大火奪走了許多寶貴生命。
The big fire ____ many people ____ their ____ lives.
questions.zh: 這場大火奪走了許多寶貴生命。
questions.explain: deprive（人）of（生命…等）：（奪去／剝奪人之生命）。寶貴的可用 precious 或 valuable。

questions.q:
滿嘴食物的時候說話是很不禮貌的。
It is impolite to speak ____ your mouth ____ ____ food.
questions.zh: 滿嘴食物的時候說話是很不禮貌的。
questions.explain: with 表示「附帶之狀況」。（with＋名詞＋形容詞片語）

questions.q:
極目所望盡是汪洋大海。
As ____ as our eyes can reach, we see ____ ____ spacious ocean.
questions.zh: 極目所望盡是汪洋大海。
questions.explain: as far as（到…程度；到…範圍）。

sections.title: （三）連貫式翻譯
sections.instructions: 將下列中文句子翻譯成英文

questions.q: 我的故鄉是靠近一個湖泊的小村落。
questions.hint: 靠近一個湖泊：near a lake
questions.answer: My hometown is a small village near a lake.
questions.zh: 我的故鄉是靠近一個湖泊的小村落。
questions.explain: near 表示「靠近」。

questions.q: 村子前面有一條小溪，溪中有許多魚蝦。
questions.hint: 富於：abounds in / be rich in
answer: In front of the village is a stream, which abounds in fish and shrimps.
In front of the village is a stream, which is rich in fish and shrimps.
questions.zh: 村子前面有一條小溪，溪中有許多魚蝦。
questions.explain: 「富於」：abounds in；be rich in。

questions.q: 村子後面有一片樹林，我常去那裡散步。
questions.hint: 散步：take a walk / go for a walk
answer: In back of it is a forest, where I often take a walk.
Behind it is a forest, where I often take a walk.
questions.zh: 村子後面有一片樹林，我常去那裡散步。
questions.explain: 「散步」：take a walk；go for a walk。

questions.q: 大部分村民是農夫，他們靠種田為生。
questions.hint: 謀生：make/earn one's living；靠種田：by farming
answer: Most of the villagers are farmers, who make a living by farming.
Most of the villagers are farmers, who earn their living by farming.
Most of the villagers are farmers, who earn their bread by farming.
Most of the villagers are farmers, who earn their livelihood by farming.
questions.zh: 大部分村民是農夫，他們靠種田為生。
questions.explain: 「謀生」：make（或 earn）one's living／earn one's bread／earn one's livelihood 均可。

questions.q: 我的故鄉風景優美，它永遠留在我的腦海中。
questions.hint: 留在某人腦海中：live in one's memory
questions.answer: My hometown is beautiful and it will live in my memory forever.
questions.zh: 我的故鄉風景優美，它永遠留在我的腦海中。
questions.explain: 「留在某人腦海中」：live in one's memory。

sections.title: （四）選答案測驗
sections.instructions:
閱讀短文，並選出空格內最適當的答案：

In social life, time __1.__ a very important part. In the United States, guests __2.__ feel they are not highly regarded if the invitation __3.__ a dinner party is given only three or four days __4.__ the party date. The meaning of time differs __5.__ different parts of the world, too. __6.__ example, promptness is valued highly in American life. In the U. S., no one would __7.__ keeping a business associate __8.__ an hour; it would be too impolite. When equals meet, a person who is five minutes late is __9.__ to make a short apology. If he is less than five minutes late, he will say a few words of __10.__.

【詞彙及短語提示】
1. social life: 社會生活
2. guests: 名 客人
3. are not highly regarded: 未受到十分的尊重
4. invitation: 名 邀請函
5. the party date: 宴會日子
6. promptness: 名 機敏；迅速
7. is valued highly: 受重視
8. a business associate: 商業夥伴
9. equals: 名 同輩
10. make a short apology: 做簡短的道歉

questions.q: In social life, time ____ a very important part.
questions.zh: 在社會生活中，時間扮演非常重要的一部分。
questions.explain: play a very important part：扮演重要之一部分。

questions.q: In the United States, guests ____ feel they are not highly regarded if the invitation (3) a dinner party is given...
questions.zh: 在美國，客人往往覺得如果邀請函…他們並未受到十分的尊重。
questions.explain: (A) used to：過去習慣於；(B) only to：但是；(C) tend to：有…傾向；(D) take to：沉迷於。

questions.q: ...if the invitation ____ a dinner party is given only three or four days (4) the party date.
questions.zh: …如果晚宴的邀請函只在宴會日期的三、四天前才發出…
questions.explain: 「邀請人參加宴會」用 invite (人) to a party，名詞 invitation 亦搭配 to。

questions.q: ...is given only three or four days ____ the party date.
questions.zh: …只在宴會日期的三、四天前才發出。
questions.explain: (A) 在…期間；(B) 在…之後；(C) 在…之內；(D) 在…之前。

questions.q: The meaning of time differs ____ different parts of the world, too.
questions.zh: 時間的意義在世界不同地方也有所不同。
questions.explain: differ from＋N：不同於；differ in＋N：在…方面不同。

questions.q: ____ example, promptness is valued highly in American life.
questions.zh: 例如，準時在美國人的生活中受到高度重視。
questions.explain: For example＝For instance（比如；例如）。

questions.q: In the U. S., no one would ____ keeping a business associate (8) an hour; it would be too impolite.
questions.zh: 在美國，沒有人會想到讓商業夥伴等待一個小時；那樣太不禮貌了。
questions.explain: (A) 尋找；(B) 了解；(C) 想到；(D) 在於。

questions.q: ...keeping a business associate ____ an hour; it would be too impolite.
questions.zh: …讓商業夥伴等候一個小時；那樣太不禮貌了。
questions.explain: keep (人) waiting for＋時間：讓（人）等候多少時間。

questions.q: When equals meet, a person who is five minutes late is ____ to make a short apology.
questions.zh: 同輩相聚時，遲到五分鐘的人會被認為理當做個簡短的道歉。
questions.explain: be expected：被要求；被視為當然要做…；be demanded：被要求；be requested：被要求；be inspected：被檢查。

questions.q: If he is less than five minutes late, he will say a few words of ____.
questions.zh: 如果他遲到不到五分鐘，他會說幾句解釋的話。
questions.explain: (A) 抱怨；(B) 解釋；(C) 表達；(D) 感激。
